statement: You are given a non-empty doubly linked list, listed head to tail in values. Each node has a next pointer and a prev pointer.
Reverse the list in place by rewiring every node's next and prev pointers, so the old tail becomes the new head.
Return the reversed list, read from its new head.

examples.explanation: Each node is detached in turn and placed in front of the reversed part, so the former tail 4 ends up as the head.
After all three nodes are rewired, 7 is the head and 5 is the tail.
